english.note: Use this as the all-purpose Cantonese noun for illegal access to a computer system.

exampleSentences.english: The hack of our company server this morning meant we couldn't work all morning.
exampleSentences.traditional: 今朝公司個伺服器俾人黑客入侵，成個上午都開唔到工。
